name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source search database for full-text, vector and hybrid search with real-time indexing, SQL and a JSON HTTP API.

alerts.message: There is no web UI: the domain serves the HTTP API with authentication enabled. Use basic auth with MANTICORE_ADMIN_USER and the generated MANTICORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The admin is created only on the first start: to change the password later, run SET PASSWORD and then set MANTICORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD to the same value, because the healthcheck signs in with it.
